events.title: Anne Boleyn is beheaded at the Tower of London
events.description: Henry VIII's second queen, mother of the future Elizabeth I, was executed by a French swordsman on charges widely seen as fabricated. Henry was betrothed to Jane Seymour the next day.
events.html: Henry VIII's second queen, mother of the future Elizabeth I, was executed by a French swordsman on charges widely seen as fabricated. Henry was betrothed to Jane Seymour the next day.

events.title: French victory at Rocroi breaks Spain's military reputation
events.description: The young Duke of Enghien, later the Great Condé, defeated the Spanish army at Rocroi in northern France. The defeat of the famed tercios signalled the decline of Spanish power on land.
events.html: The young Duke of Enghien, later the Great Condé, defeated the Spanish army at Rocroi in northern France. The defeat of the famed tercios signalled the decline of Spanish power on land.

events.title: England is declared a Commonwealth
events.description: Four months after the execution of Charles I, the Rump Parliament declared England a 'Commonwealth and Free State' without king or House of Lords. It gave way to Cromwell's Protectorate in 1653.
events.html: Four months after the execution of Charles I, the Rump Parliament declared England a 'Commonwealth and Free State' without king or House of Lords. It gave way to Cromwell's Protectorate in 1653.

events.title: T. E. Lawrence dies after a motorcycle crash
events.description: T. E. Lawrence, 'Lawrence of Arabia', died six days after crashing near his Dorset cottage. He had served with the Arab Revolt and wrote Seven Pillars of Wisdom.
events.html: T. E. Lawrence, 'Lawrence of Arabia', died six days after crashing near his Dorset cottage. He had served with the Arab Revolt and wrote Seven Pillars of Wisdom.

events.title: Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis dies in New York
events.description: The former First Lady died aged 64. Her composure after her husband's assassination in 1963 made her an enduring public figure, and she later worked as a book editor.
